card.name: The word a before restricted program
card.fires_on: The article "a" right after "available only through" (or "only available through") in REMS statements. It predicts that "restricted program" or "restricted distribution program" follows.

modes.label: Only available through a
modes.description: The article "a" after "available only through" in a boxed-warning or REMS sentence naming a drug.
